impact.summary: On October 6, 2026, DNB announced an approximately 400-FTE reduction in Technology & Services, planned for Q4 2026. The bank links the restructuring to agentic AI taking over manual tasks, process simplification and a changed skills mix. This records the announced plan, not independently verified completed dismissals.
impact.summaryEn: On October 6, 2026, DNB announced an approximately 400-FTE reduction in Technology & Services, planned for Q4 2026. The bank links the restructuring to agentic AI taking over manual tasks, process simplification and a changed skills mix. This records the announced plan, not independently verified completed dismissals.
impact.counterEvidence: About 400 full-time equivalents in Technology & Services, targeted Q4 2026. Also process simplification and skills mix changes. Norwegian bank, not Dutch central bank. Single company-origin account; independently demonstrated causal allocation to AI and completed reductions are not established.

impact.summary: Fair Isaac committed on October 1, 2026 to eliminate approximately 15% of positions, with notifications beginning the week of October 5. Its October 6 filing cites fewer organizational layers, process and tool optimization, and AI-driven product development. Completion was expected by fiscal Q3 2027; the filing gives no absolute job count.
impact.summaryEn: Fair Isaac committed on October 1, 2026 to eliminate approximately 15% of positions, with notifications beginning the week of October 5. Its October 6 filing cites fewer organizational layers, process and tool optimization, and AI-driven product development. Completion was expected by fiscal Q3 2027; the filing gives no absolute job count.
impact.counterEvidence: Committed October 1, filed October 6; notifications week of October 5. Filing gives 15%, not 570 people. Reuters estimated 570 from older headcount; do not store that as a company-confirmed count. Single company-origin account; independently demonstrated causal allocation to AI and completed reductions are not established.

impact.summary: On April 15, 2026, Snap announced changes affecting approximately 1,000 team members, including 16% of full-time employees, and separately closed over 300 vacancies. Its CEO cited AI-enabled reductions in repetitive work alongside investment prioritization and a path to profitability. The stated cuts are announced changes, not a verified completed total.

Its CEO cited AI-enabled reductions in repetitive work alongside investment prioritization and a path to profitability. The stated cuts are announced changes, not a verified completed total.
impact.counterEvidence: About 1,000 team members, including 16% full-time staff; separately more than 300 open roles closed. Profitability and prioritization also cited; unfilled openings are not additional layoffs. Single company-origin account; independently demonstrated causal allocation to AI and completed reductions are not established.
